event.title: UK Charges Man with Genocide-Related Offences from Rwanda
event.canonical_title: UK Charges Man with Genocide-Related Offences from Rwanda
event.summary: Vincent Brown, also known as Vincent Bajinya, has been charged in the UK with one offence related to genocide and six offences related to murder as a crime against humanity. The 65-year-old is set to appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court to face these charges, marking the first prosecution in the UK connected to the 1994 Rwanda genocide.
